prompt: Exactly as in the image: above the sunlit bazaar lane the Munchly Mango carton floats in mid-air, bobbing gently up and down, its printed label unchanged and legible; the ripe mangoes around it drift slowly at different depths; warm golden haze and dust glow in the light. A slow push in toward the carton. Everything keeps its form; no object appears, vanishes or changes shape; no text or lettering appears. Cinematic, photorealistic, smooth and slow, no handheld shake.
